name: Magnesium Ribbon
semanticDescription: A strip of elemental magnesium metal used in CBSE Class 10 Chemistry Activity 1.1 (Burning of Magnesium Ribbon). Features dual collections: Magnesium_Ribbon_Full (curled ribbon showing shiny cleaned elemental Mg metal vs dull protective MgO/MgCO3 passivation layer, alongside sandpaper sheet) and Magnesium_Ribbon_Detail (micro-structural cross-section showing pure Mg core, surface oxide layer, mechanical abrasion vectors, calipers, and technical plaque).
simplifications: Thickness slightly exaggerated (0.8 mm vs ~0.2 mm real ribbon) for visual clarity at educational camera distances.
Ribbon demonstrates the pedagogical concept of cleaning with sandpaper before combustion to remove protective oxide coating.

materials.look: lustrous silvery-white pure elemental magnesium, metallic 0.98, roughness 0.18
dull matte grey protective magnesium oxide/carbonate passivation layer
coarse brown silicon carbide abrasive sandpaper
